Service Specification 1. The wheat genotyping array should contain a minimum of 30,000 predefined S NP markers distributed across the A, B and D subgenomes, providing genome-w ide coverage of the hexaploid wheat genome. 2. The wheat Array should contain markers validated for high throughput screeni ng in wheat breeding programs or trait mapping studies. 3. The firm should also provide the description of issues concerning DNA isolation & quality check. 4. The bidder should provide raw intensity data along with processed geno type calls, with an overall genotyping call rate of ≥90% and SNP manifes t/annotation files including SNP ID, chromosome, and physical position along with the final dataset. 5. A good quality data must be provided within 30 days after confirmation of the receipt of good quality DNA. 6. The vendor shall have a proven track record of at least 3 years in suc cessfully processing similar high-density wheat SNP genotyping arrays containing >30,000 markers and shall furnish documentary evidence s uch as work orders/purchase orders. 7. The bidder should furnish list of institutions/organizations that have previo usly utilized the same or equivalent wheat SNP array and services. 8. Bidder should provide valid manufacture authorization certificate from th e Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) for operation and servicing of th e array genotyping instruments used for this work. 9. All raw data, processed genotype data, and derived outputs shall be the exclu sive property of the Purchaser/Institute. 10. The vendor shall maintain strict confidentiality of all samples and data and shall not disclose, publish, or reuse the data without prior written approval of th e Purchaser. 11. The vendor shall not claim any intellectual property rights over the data ge nerated from the Purchaser’s samples. 12. Failure to meet minimum quality standards may require re-genotyping at no a dditional cost or proportionate payment deduction. 13. Genomic samples (DNA/RNA) shall not be transported outside the territorial bo undaries of India, in strict compliance with Government of India regulations. Ser vice Provider has to furnish an undertaking in this regard stating that sample pr ocessing will be done with in the country (India) only. 14. The vendor shall ensure secure handling, storage and transfer of electronic ge notyping data, and the complete final dataset shall be supplied to the Purchase r in an accessible electronic format. . 5.
